"""Execute unchanged remaining recipes in a fresh committed-source checkout."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path('/home/alex/workspace/rupurt/rey')
CAMPAIGN = Path('/var/tmp/transit-table-75-_el6xx0v')
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'], cwd=ROOT)
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='transit-ci-', dir='/var/tmp'))
checkout, scratch = directory/'src', directory/'tmp'
scratch.mkdir()
state = {'revision':revision, 'checkout':str(checkout), 'directory':str(directory), 'tier':'bindings_tail', 'completed':False}
(CAMPAIGN/'clean-bindings-tail-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')
env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('REY_') and k not in ('KUBECONFIG','LOG_LEVEL','LOG_FORMAT')}
def run(*args, cwd=ROOT):
    subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,check=True)

# Reuse the committed inventory runner without editing it or any task. The
# separate tier name and eight-task expected inventory prevent a full-lane claim.
driver = CAMPAIGN/'selected-bindings-tail-driver.py'
driver.write_text('''import hashlib, importlib.util, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("transit_ci", root/"tests/ci.py")
ci=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(ci)
original=ci.LANES["bindings"]
selected=original[original.index("bindings::beam-sdk-test"):]
assert selected == ["bindings::beam-sdk-test", "bindings::sdk-interop", "test::model", "test::model-delivery", "test::sql-rewrites", "test::sql", "bindings::grpc-faults", "bindings::connector-preparation"]
ci.LANES["bindings_tail"]=selected
proof={"scope":"Selected suffix of the standard bindings inventory; not a complete bindings lane.", "original_inventory":original, "selected_tasks":selected, "driver_source":Path(__file__).read_text(), "driver_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "runner_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"tests/ci.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "suite_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"tests/verification/suite.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(root/".cache/ci").mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(root/".cache/ci/bindings_tail.selection.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+"\\n")
print("Selected clean task inventory: "+json.dumps(selected),flush=True)
sys.argv=["tests/ci.py","bindings_tail"]
ci.main()
''')
try:
    run('git','clone','--quiet','--local','--no-hardlinks','--no-checkout',str(ROOT),str(checkout))
    run('git','checkout','--quiet','--detach',revision,cwd=checkout)
    print(f'Clean selected bindings tail: {revision} in {checkout}',flush=True)
    run('nix','develop','--option','eval-cache','false','--command','env',f'TMPDIR={scratch}','just','transit-board::install',cwd=checkout)
    run('nix','develop','.#bindings','--option','eval-cache','false','--command','env',f'TMPDIR={scratch}','ERL_FLAGS=+S 2:2 +SDcpu 1 +SDio 1','python3','-B',str(driver),cwd=checkout)
except BaseException:
    print(f'Incomplete selected clean run retained at {directory}',flush=True)
    raise
else:
    evidence=ROOT/'.cache/ci/clean'/f'{revision[:12]}-{directory.name}'
    shutil.copytree(checkout/'.cache/ci',evidence)
    state.update(completed=True,evidence=str(evidence))
    (CAMPAIGN/'clean-bindings-tail-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')
    shutil.rmtree(directory)
    print(f'All eight selected tasks passed; exact evidence: {evidence}',flush=True)

"""Audit exact task coverage without promoting incomplete runs to full passes."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
ROOT=Path('/home/alex/workspace/rupurt/rey')
CAMPAIGN=Path('/var/tmp/transit-table-75-_el6xx0v')
suite=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/verification/suite.json').read_text())
expected=[task for lane in suite['tiers']['ordinary'] for task in suite['lanes'][lane]]
assert len(expected)==len(set(expected))==75
history=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/verification/results/m46-clean-development-2026-10-07.json').read_text())['runs']
segments=[]
def prefix(log,lane,tasks):
    old=next(r for r in history if r['log']==log)
    selected=old['tasks'][:len(tasks)] if lane=='bindings' else [t for t in old['tasks'] if t['lane']==lane]
    segments.append(dict(lane=lane,selection='Completed selected tasks from an incomplete run; the original full run failed.',expected_tasks=tasks,log=log,log_sha256=old['log_sha256'],metadata=old['metadata'],tasks=selected,requires_completed_run=False))
prefix('general-definition-ci-clean4.log','core',suite['lanes']['core'])
for lane,revision,directory,log in [
 ('growth','e8585d6ee366','transit-ci-3xhcqru4','general-definition-clean-growth1.log'),
 ('experience','72d9a6e3d727','transit-ci-ips7rp9b','general-definition-clean-experience2.log'),
 ('launchers','d4c4362f4548','transit-ci-p3ckljdf','general-definition-clean-launchers1.log')]:
    base=ROOT/'.cache/ci/clean'/f'{revision}-{directory}'
    metadata=json.loads((base/f'{lane}.meta.json').read_text())
    assert metadata['revision'].startswith(revision)
    segments.append(dict(lane=lane,selection='Complete separate clean lane.',expected_tasks=suite['lanes'][lane],log=log,log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((CAMPAIGN/log).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),metadata=metadata,tasks=json.loads((base/f'{lane}.json').read_text()),requires_completed_run=True))
bindings=suite['lanes']['bindings']; split=bindings.index('bindings::beam-sdk-test')
prefix('general-definition-clean-bindings2.log','bindings',bindings[:split])
state=json.loads((CAMPAIGN/'clean-bindings-tail-state.json').read_text()); base=Path(state['checkout'])/'.cache/ci'
if not base.exists(): base=Path(state['evidence'])
log='general-definition-clean-bindings-tail1.log'
segments.append(dict(lane='bindings',selection='Fresh selected suffix of unchanged standard recipes; not a complete bindings lane.',expected_tasks=bindings[split:],log=log,log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((CAMPAIGN/log).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),metadata=json.loads((base/'bindings_tail.meta.json').read_text()),tasks=json.loads((base/'bindings_tail.json').read_text()),driver=json.loads((base/'bindings_tail.selection.json').read_text()),requires_completed_run=True))
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
for segment in segments:
    wanted=segment['expected_tasks']; names=[t['task'] for t in segment['tasks']]
    assert names==wanted[:len(names)], (segment['lane'],names)
    segment['selected_tasks_passed']=names==wanted and all(t['exit_code']==0 for t in segment['tasks']) and (not segment['requires_completed_run'] or segment['metadata']['completed'])
    segment['changed_paths_after_source_revision']=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',segment['metadata']['revision'],head],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
assert [task for segment in segments for task in segment['expected_tasks']]==expected
runtime='436a07979a89ea7077ad382607cc107d97e1aa7d'
changes=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',runtime,head],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
formatting=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/verification/results/m46-consumer-checkpoints-2026-10-07.json').read_text())['elixir_format_check']
allowed={f['path'] for f in formatting['files']}
assert all(p.startswith(('tests/','docs/')) or p.endswith('.md') or p in allowed for p in changes), changes
for f in formatting['files']:
    before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',runtime+':'+f['path']],cwd=ROOT)
    assert hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()==f['before_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['after_sha256']
completed=all(s['selected_tasks_passed'] for s in segments)
output=dict(scope='Ordinary task coverage across exact clean source revisions. This is not one completed ci.py all run, nor five complete same-revision lanes. Runtime semantics are unchanged; two Elixir source files have independently verified AST-preserving formatting.',head=head,runtime_semantics_revision=runtime,formatting_evidence=formatting,changed_paths_since_runtime=changes,expected_tasks=expected,complete_task_coverage=completed,passed_tasks=sum(t['exit_code']==0 for s in segments for t in s['tasks']),segments=segments)
(CAMPAIGN/'clean-coverage-current.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:output[k] for k in ('head','complete_task_coverage','passed_tasks')}))
